predecessors.name: Yan (An Lushan)
predecessors.text: the Chengde circuit round Zhen Prefecture, left to the Yan general Li Baozhen after the Yan fell

successors.name: Jin (Former Jin)
successors.text: 'Jin forces took Zhen Prefecture in autumn 922, ending the state'

rulers.name: Wang Rong (Prince of Zhao)
rulers.title: military governor from 883; Prince of Zhao from 907

ledger.x: 763: the Chengde circuit stays with a Yan general.
907: the Chengde circuit becomes the Wushun and its governor Prince of Zhao.
910: Wang Rong breaks with Later Liang.

wars.name: Battle of Boxiang (911)
wars.outcome: Jin and Zhao forces (with Yiwu's army) routed the Later Liang army at Boxiang in spring 911; no land changed hands.

wars.name: Jin conquest of Zhao
wars.outcome: After Wang Rong's murder in spring 921 Li Cunxu refused Zhang Wenli's submission; Jin took Zhen Prefecture in autumn 922.

certainty.note: Circuit frontiers with no line on the pages.
